meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 转为公众号排版，生成配图与标题建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常写公众号文章，想从 Markdown 快速生成精美排版
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat article HTML with images and title suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write WeChat articles and want to quickly generate polished layouts from Markdown

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将 Markdown 文章转换为微信公众号 HTML，生成封面图、信息图，创建草稿，提供标题建议，并去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你要求将 Markdown 转为公众号文章、生成配图、创建草稿或优化标题时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML。
say.note: 执行 convert 命令生成 HTML。

say.text: 为这篇文章生成一个封面图。
say.note: 调用 generate_cover 生成封面。

say.text: 给这篇文章建议几个标题。
say.note: 运行 title suggest 获取标题候选。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert Markdown articles to WeChat Official Account HTML, generate cover images and infographics, create drafts, suggest titles, and remove AI writing traces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to convert Markdown to WeChat article, generate images, create drafts, or suggest titles.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown to WeChat article HTML.
say_en.note: Runs convert command to generate HTML.

say_en.text: Generate a cover image for this article.
Suggest some titles for this article.
say_en.note: Runs title suggest to get title candidates.
